'''Endor Draft''' is [[Decipher]]'s sealed deck draft format for the [[Endor (expansion)|Endor]] expansion, published in the June 1999 [[Endor Rulesheet|Endor Rules Supplement]]. Each player drafts six Endor packs and builds a 40-card deck. The [[Players Committee]]'s ''Alternate Format Tournament Guide'' (revised September 2015) reprints the rules.<ref name="endorrules">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/endorrules.pdf Endor Rules Supplement] (endorrules.pdf), Decipher (June 1999), "Endor Draft Tournament Rules". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/endorrules.pdf Internet Archive]. Transcription: [[Endor Rulesheet]].</ref><ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' booster draft
* '''Defined by:''' Decipher (1999); reprinted by the Players Committee (2015)
* '''Card pool:''' six unopened Endor packs per player, 40-card decks
* '''In use:''' 1999 &ndash; listed in 2015
* '''GEMP:''' none

== Card pool ==
Decipher's rules, reprinted unchanged in the Players Committee guide:<ref name="endorrules" /><ref name="afg" />
* It is a Decipher-sanctioned sealed deck event that needs a sanctioned tournament director and at least 8 players. Instead of trading cards with one opponent, players choose cards from a much larger pool.
* An even number of players is preferred; otherwise the tournament director drafts in place of a player but does not play. Each player (and the director, if drafting) provides 6 unopened Endor packs.
* Each player is randomly assigned Light or Dark, with equal numbers of each.
* Players sit in groups of 6 where possible, otherwise 4 (never more than two groups of 4), Light and Dark alternating.
* Each player opens a pack and has 45 seconds to pick the first card, then 30 seconds for each later pick. The card must usually be of the player's assigned side; a foil may be taken regardless of side. A player passed a pack with no cards of their side passes it on without picking.
* Packs pass right in the first round, left in the second, alternating until all six packs are drafted.
* The tournament then follows Decipher's standard sealed deck format, except that deck building lasts 15 minutes. A player with fewer than 40 cards of their side must play as close to 40 cards as possible.

== History ==
Decipher presented Endor Draft as a new tournament format made possible by "the standalone nature of the Endor expansion".<ref name="endorrules" /> [[DecipherCon 2002]] scheduled a "Death Star II/Endor Draft" sealed event on 1 November 2002.<ref name="swsched">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/events/eventschedule-otherccg.html Event schedule: Star Wars, Young Jedi, Jedi Knights], DecipherCon 2002, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021023190505/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/events/eventschedule-otherccg.html Internet Archive].</ref> The Players Committee guide of 2015 prints the Endor Draft rules under the heading "from Decipher's Rules Supplement for the Endor Expansion" and lists [[Death Star II Booster Draft]], with three Endor and three Death Star II packs, among its own formats.<ref name="afg" />
